Name: Anton Vorontsov. Custom Romanceable NPC
Author: mavismckenna
Description:
[b]About Anton[/b]

Anton came to the valley without deciding how long he would stay. He works remotely, drinks far too much coffee, plays guitar when he thinks nobody is listening, and hides serious answers behind dry jokes. His closest companions include Sebastian, Sam, Abigail, and his cat, Mrak.

This mod adds Anton as a fully romanceable bachelor with friendship, dating, engagement, marriage, breakup, and divorce content. His dialogue and events focus on everyday intimacy, personal boundaries, and family.

[b]Features[/b]

- A fully romanceable custom NPC with his own home, schedule, gift tastes, birthday, dialogue, portraits, sprites, and seasonal outfits.
- Heart events at 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 14 hearts.
- Additional events for married life.
- Seasonal, rainy-day, festival, dating, engagement, breakup, divorce, and marriage dialogue.
- A custom forest home that can be visited from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM before marriage.
- Detailed spouse content: a spouse room, patio routine, computer work, farm activities, household help, seasonal dialogue, and post-marriage dates.
- Several post-marriage events.
- Mrak, Anton’s cat, moves to the farmhouse after marriage.
- Compatibility with Stardew Valley Expanded and Sunberry Village.

[heading]Language[/heading]
[b]Russian and English are included in one download.[/b]

The mod automatically follows the language selected in Stardew Valley. Russian uses the Russian text, English uses the English text, and other languages fall back to English. Restart the game after changing its language.

[b]Please note:[/b] The English translation was created using machine translation and may contain mistakes or unnatural wording. If you notice any issues, please let me know.

[b]Requirements[/b]

- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI 4.5.2 or later
- Content Patcher 2.8.0 or later
- Custom Companions 1.6.3 or later

Stardew Valley Expanded is optional. The mod includes compatibility changes when SVE is installed.

[b]Installation[/b]

1. Install SMAPI, Content Patcher, and Custom Companions.
2. Download and unzip the mod archive.
3. Copy all three included folders into your Stardew Valley `Mods` folder:
  - `AntonNPC`
  - `[SMAPI] Anton Festivals`
  - `[CC] Anton Mrak`
4. Start the game through SMAPI.

Please keep all three folders installed. They contain Anton’s main content, scripted interactions, and Mrak’s companion data.

[b]Compatibility[/b]

- Made for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.5.2+.
- Stardew Valley Expanded and Sunberry Village are supported but not required.
- Mobile and iPad versions are not currently supported.
- Back up your save before adding or removing large custom NPC mods.

[b]Recommended mod[/b]

I recommend installing [i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/51619]Smoking Mod[/url][/i]. It adds smoking mechanics and cigarette packs that can be given to Anton as gifts. This mod is optional: Anton NPC will still work without it.

[b]Content note[/b]

The mod includes references to smoking and alcohol, along with personal and family themes.

[b]Bug reports[/b]

If you find a bug, please include:

- A link to your SMAPI log.
- The in-game date, weather, time, and location where the problem occurred.
- Anton’s friendship level and current relationship status.
- Whether Stardew Valley Expanded is installed.
- A short description of what happened and what you expected to happen.

[b]mportant distribution notice[/b]

[b][size=4]THE ORIGINAL AND AUTHORIZED VERSION OF THIS MOD IS AVAILABLE EXCLUSIVELY THROUGH THIS NEXUS MODS ACCOUNT.[/size][/b]

Any copy, reupload, mirror, redistribution, or port published under another account or on another platform without my explicit permission is stolen content. If you find this mod anywhere else, please let me know through Nexus Mods or Telegram.

Just to clarify before it comes up in the comments: I used AI as a coding assistant, so the code wasn’t written entirely by me. However, all of the mod’s content, including the artwork, sprites, writing, and other creative work, was made by me.
